title: Mango and Pumpkin Spice Cake
author: Pierre Thiam (SAVEUR)
desc: A pumpkin-spice batter of flour, cinnamon, ginger, sugar, pumpkin puree, oil and four eggs with diced mango folded in, topped with fanned mango slices and baked about 2 hours at 325° in a 9-inch springform until a toothpick comes out clean.
longDesc: Pierre Thiam adapted his wife’s classic pumpkin cake for his Thanksgiving table, adding mango both in the batter and fanned over the top. Published by SAVEUR on 16 November 2015: serves 8–10; total time 2 hours 20 minutes. The oven is heated to 325°; a 9-inch springform is greased and floured; flour, cinnamon, ginger, baking soda and salt are whisked in one bowl and the sugar, pumpkin puree, oil, vanilla and eggs in another until smooth; wet is added to dry and whisked just until smooth; half a mango is diced into 1/2-inch cubes and folded in; the batter is poured into the pan and smoothed. The remaining 1 1/2 mangoes are sliced lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices and arranged in an overlapping circle on top, and the cake baked about 2 hours until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool completely on a wire rack, unmould onto a platter and dust with confectioners’ sugar.
ingredients: Unsalted butter, for greasing — quantity not printed
2 3/4 cups (12 3/8 oz) all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
1 cup canned or homemade pumpkin puree
Confectioners’ sugar, for dusting — quantity not printed
steps: Heat the oven to 325°. Grease and flour a 9-inch springform cake pan. Whisk the flour, cinnamon, ginger, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl whisk the sugar, pumpkin puree, oil, vanilla and eggs until smooth. Add the wet to the dry and whisk just until smooth.
Dice half of one mango into 1/2-inch cubes and fold into the batter. Pour into the pan and smooth the top. No time is printed for this step.
Slice the remaining 1 1/2 mangoes lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices and arrange in an overlapping circle on top.
Bake about 2 hours, until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean.
Cool completely on a wire rack. Unmould onto a platter and dust with confectioners’ sugar.
chefTips: Printed cues: ‘until smooth’, ‘just until smooth’, ‘a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean’.
Only the oven setting 325° is printed; the scale is not named.
Fan the slices evenly so the top bakes level.
commonMistakes: Over-whisking after adding wet to dry.
Unmoulding before the cake is completely cool.
healthBenefits: Pumpkin and mango add vitamin A; this is a rich cake.
culturalNote: A Pierre Thiam holiday recipe adapted from his wife’s pumpkin cake, not a traditional Senegalese cake; the page names no region.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Mango and Pumpkin Spice Cake’. Byline as printed: ‘By Pierre Thiam’. SAVEUR, 16 November 2015. Yield ‘serves 8-10’ (9 used). Total time 2 hours 20 minutes. TWO-PASS on every quantity.
Times: about 2 hours of baking (120); 20 minutes of prep is a scheduling split of the printed total. ABSENT: butter and confectioners’ sugar quantities. No oven scale printed.
